summary: The candidate improves the construction error and adds regression/documentation hardening, but dense MTP weights under a broad Linear W4A8 target still fail without an explicit ignore. Two documented plain-star ignore examples do not match in the actual exact/suffix/regex matcher.

tests.what_was_measured: Reproduced generic dense no-ignore construction failure and successful explicit-regex BF16 fallback on the prepared base.
Confirmed the candidate retains the startup failure but adds layer prefix, matched target, format, W4/A8 details, and ignore guidance.
Validated documented ignore variants, identical dense/packed pre-load construction behavior, and explicit-ignore GPU BF16 output against CPU FP32.

tests.command: python -m pytest -q <five compressed-tensors unit files including WNA16 MoE>
tests.what_was_measured: 27 passed and six unrelated ROCm-sensitive WNA16 backend-selection assertions failed; retained as an environment/suite limitation.
Candidate diff has no whitespace errors.

gpu_execution.evidence: AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950; explicit-ignore BF16 ReplicatedLinear executed on GPU with max_abs 0.03134560585021973 versus CPU FP32 reference.

remaining_counterexamples: Dense mtp.layers.0.self_attn.qkv_proj.weight with broad Linear W4A8 target and no MTP ignore still raises during construction, so the original NEXTN startup failure remains.
The documented plain entries mtp.* and model.mtp.* do not match MTP children because non-re: ignores are exact or dotted-suffix matches, not globs.
Actual packed MTP checkpoint loading remains unverified; construction fails before either dense or packed checkpoint tensor names can be inspected.
remaining_limitations: No Qwen3-Next weights or end-to-end NEXTN server startup test was available.
The original 2x H100 NVL TP2/EP2 architecture was unavailable; GPU execution used one AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950.
No native source changed, so native rebuild was not applicable.
Six unrelated WNA16 backend-selection assertions failed in a broader ROCm test run; candidate-relevant tests passed 21/21.
